parameters.apprise_url_plus: vonage://${ customer_secrets.{{ params.apikey_secret }} }:${ customer_secrets.{{ params.secret_secret }} }@${ customer_secrets.{{ params.from_phone_secret }} }
parameters.description:
`msg-to-vonage-sms` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Vonage destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise), the open-source notification library, driven entirely by your own stored credentials at no cost. A paid variant ($0.001 per message) delivers to additional Vonage destinations bound per enrollment.
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Vonage destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

apikey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Vonage apikey

from_phone_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Vonage from phone

secret_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Vonage secret
